<!--
Keep the body proportional to the change. Summary and Validation are required;
for small PRs, use just these two sections.
Add Motivation or Changes only when the problem, tradeoffs, or implementation
decisions need more explanation. Add Migration or Usage for compatibility and
apply steps, or Preview when images help review visible changes.
Replace these prompts with concrete details and remove unused sections.
-->

## Summary

<!--
Explain the existing problem and resulting behavior in one or two sentences.
Include compatibility changes, required migration, and material limitations
when relevant. Describe the final diff, without conversational history.
-->

## Validation

<!--
List checks actually performed and their results, including relevant commands
or manual checks. For documentation-only changes, a diff review is sufficient.
If checks failed, were blocked, or were not run, say why and identify relevant gaps.

For protocol changes, include generated-contract and TypeScript/Rust wire
compatibility checks. For capture, encoding, audio, or performance changes,
identify the platform and representative workload checked. Distinguish automated
tests, actual rendered-output checks, and benchmarks. Performance comparisons
should use comparable settings and verify output correctness.
-->

<!--
Optional issue footer: use Fixes #<issue-number> or Closes #<issue-number> only
for a real issue this PR resolves; use Refs #<issue-number> for related issues.
Omit the footer when no issue applies.
-->
